mechanism: Betamethasone may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of atenolol through sodium and fluid retention, while atenolol may mask hypoglycemic symptoms and increase hyperglycemia risk from corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; adjust atenolol dosing if needed and monitor for hyperglycemia; educate patient on signs of hypoglycemia that may be masked by beta-blockade.
